description: Abstract conformance traces for core/1 continuity and keel.provisioned-context.v1; not executed runtime conformance. Unless explicitly labeled as another selected profile or a general core requirement, cases use the provisioned memory-only profile. C, C1 and C2 denote conversation UUIDs; A is the recorded conversation actor and R or B its requester unless stated otherwise. Distinct symbols denote distinct scoped identities. Otherwise-valid messages satisfy current authentication or eligible exact-copy handling, addressing, structure, action authorization and response-audience requirements. Setup and guard events are observable requirements, not a prescribed wire format, storage representation or test implementation. A generic scope rejection is evaluated before historical disposition lookup and is not a semantic refusal or evidence of past non-execution.

cases.name: core conversation traffic requires an explicitly selected usable continuity profile

steps.event: Peers share core/1, trust configuration and a reachable WebSocket but have not selected an applicable continuity profile
A participant attempts to start a conversation
expect: withhold conversation sending or reject before semantic handling under an applicable binding policy
bare core support, a valid certificate and a connection do not establish a context
do not infer a private setup mechanism from ignorable metadata

cases.name: provisioning establishes an empty context before either endpoint sends

steps.event: Both endpoints independently authorize the same trusted facility and select keel.provisioned-context.v1

The actor or its authorized facility allocates fresh C using cryptographically secure UUIDv4 randomness, reserves it for actor A and requester R on actual connection W, and installs matching descriptors and empty contexts
Only A has installed its receive guard and reported ready
expect: neither endpoint is enabled to send conversation frames
local readiness alone permits no admission
setup has accepted no request and opened no turn or approval

steps.event: R also validates its descriptor and installs its receive guard; the facility confirms both guards ready
expect: only now may the facility activate guards for admission
R learns authorized C before signing an opening say or approval

steps.event: The facility activates the first guard
expect: keep both senders disabled until both guards are active

steps.event: The facility activates the second guard
expect: the facility may now enable the senders in ordered steps
no simultaneous activation or application work is required

cases.name: a locally ready guard rejects traffic before bilateral readiness and activation

steps.event: A has installed its guard for C and reported local readiness, but the facility has not confirmed both endpoints ready or activated A for admission
An otherwise valid opening say S signed for C arrives prematurely
expect: generic binding rejection: close the original associated connection with WebSocket code 1008 if still open, otherwise discard without response; no identifying close-reason details
no core disposition, new semantic handling or reservation of the presented message ID
do not create or recreate a conversation from the frame
local readiness is not activation or permission to accept S
failure closes this attempted setup rather than partially admitting work

cases.name: a provisioner needs authority from each endpoint

steps.event: Facility F is authorized by actor A but has no authority to configure requester R
F attempts to provision both endpoints for one conversation
expect: R rejects setup
neither endpoint may be enabled to send under an incomplete bilateral setup
authority over A does not confer authority over R

cases.name: inconsistent or missing descriptors fail setup

steps.event: For each independent attempt, the endpoints disagree on the namespace, core profile, continuity profile, participant roles, conversation C or actual connection association, or a required input is absent
The endpoints validate the setup
expect: do not report a completed ready setup
do not admit conversation traffic
do not derive the missing association from an untrusted frame

cases.name: fresh allocation cannot reuse an arbitrary requester key

steps.event: A requester offers its old conversation UUID, a resettable counter-derived UUID or a key determined only by its URL as a fresh allocation
The trusted facility establishes a new scope
expect: allocate C through the required cryptographically secure UUIDv4 procedure instead
do not deliberately reuse a previous allocation
regenerate a collision with retained allocations
no permanent registry of every historical allocation is required

cases.name: setup failure invalidates the allocation rather than partially opening it

steps.event: Both endpoints are preparing allocation C but the second endpoint fails readiness or the connection is lost
The facility handles setup failure
expect: invalidate the allocation and any installed guards
do not enable conversation senders or admit work
a later setup needs a fresh C on a fresh connection

cases.name: repeated setup cannot reset active state or resurrect retired state

steps.event: C is active and contains accepted S and its disposition
The same setup is requested again
expect: at most observe the same still-live setup without mutation
do not replace its context with empty state or forget S

steps.event: C is retired and an old setup instruction is replayed
expect: do not reenable C
